description: RSSA core item types (rssa:type). Custom types use reverse-domain names with at least three labels, e.g. com.example.supply.delay. New core types are added by proposal (GOVERNANCE.md).

types.exception.reported: Something went wrong that others need to know
types.question.asked: Asking for input from the group, an agent or a role
types.answer.posted: A substantive reply to a question
types.reaction: Agree, disagree or acknowledge; points at its target with thr:in-reply-to; tallied, never threaded
